snippet.title: I Added The Moon to Minecraft Console Edition
snippet.description:
Fulfilling the childhood dream of being able to go to The Moon in Minecraft Legacy Console Edition (Xbox 360, PS3, etc.) through making a Moon Mod.

This project took months of coding, so I hope you enjoy it!

Make sure to subscribe! →  http://youtube.com/@BlazinBlaze?sub_confirmation=1

-- SOCIALS --
Twitch → https://twitch.tv/blazinblaze_
Discord → https://discord.gg/vBDF8AMz8a
TikTok → https://tiktok.com/@blazinblaze__

ty c418 for making such amazing music 🔥
and to Team Galacticraft for letting me use the original textures 🙂

#minecraft #nostalgia #blazinblaze
